verdict.rationale: llamafile's support docs state it ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan, which covers the multi-vendor core of the story. Community reports add real caveats: faster GPU performance on Windows needed dev tools installed, one user's CUDA build failed and fell back to CPU, and another saw nearly all processing stay on the CPU. These are isolated, older reports rather than a documented counter-example, so they lower the verdict to partial rather than disputed. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the vendor-specific kernels (CUDA/ROCm) and how to enable them, evidence that GPU acceleration works reliably out of the box without installing toolkits, and independent hands-on confirmation of AMD acceleration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels

citations.quote: llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, and Vulkan.
One file runs on 6 operating systems, with GPU support.
The dev tools are only required to be installed, right now, if you want get faster GPU performance.
